assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Flight battery is swollen, leaking, punctured, or shows other visible damage.
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; reject damaged or swollen cells — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Battery or power-distribution wiring has exposed conductors, melted insulation, or visible scorching.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e5 (LiPo flight battery, 4S) / Electronics block b1 (Battery and power distribution)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; power-on check for abnormal heat or odor — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Sharp burrs or edges are present on the shell or folding arms and can cut skin during handling.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / BOM m3 (Carbon-fibre folding arms)
defects.check_method: Visual and careful hand-sweep inspection — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Top and bottom shells do not mate flush, or the split-line step exceeds 0.1 mm.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: Split-line step ≤ 0.1 mm
defects.check_method: Measure assembled split-line step with a depth gauge — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Shell mating faces or boss pilots are visibly out of tolerance, causing misalignment or poor screw engagement.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: ±0.1 mm on mating faces and boss pilots
defects.check_method: Measure mating faces and boss pilots with suitable gauges — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: One or more motors, ESC channels, or propellers fail to operate normally during a controlled functional test.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e2 (4-in-1 brushless ESC, 4-channel) / BOM e3 (Brushless outrunner motor) / BOM e4 (Propeller set) / Electronics block b3 (Propulsion system)
defects.check_method: Controlled motor and propulsion functional test with propellers secured or removed — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Wi-Fi connection or vision-compute function is absent or intermittent during the functional check.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e6 (Wi-Fi vision compute module) / Electronics block b4 (Vision compute and Wi-Fi)
defects.check_method: Connect over Wi-Fi and run a brief vision-function test — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Shell finish has visible scratches, sink marks, or color variation from the graphite appearance.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / BOM m1 (Top shell) / BOM m2 (Bottom shell)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under D65 light at 50 cm; compare with approved sample — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
